title: Bread for the Neighbors

readiness.math: numerals 2 to 4, with dots to count; counting out a set of that many
readiness.reading: numerals only; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: These baskets are for our neighbors. Each basket has a number, and little dots to count. That's how many people live in that house.

older.prompt: Read the number on each basket. Put in exactly that many rolls.
older.hint: Count the rolls as you put them in. Stop when you reach the number on the basket.

steps.prompt: Look at the number on each basket. Put in that many rolls, one for each dot.
steps.hint: Put one roll on each dot. When every dot has a roll, that basket is full.

feedback.full: This basket already has {n} rolls. That's just right for this house.
feedback.all_good: Every basket has the right number of rolls.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Every family has bread now! Two rolls are left over. One for you, and one for Miss Miriam.

intro.speaker: tobias

older.journal_line: I helped Mr. Tobias fill the bread baskets: 4 rolls, 6 rolls and 5 rolls, one for each person.

journal_line: I helped Mr. Tobias fill the bread baskets: 2 rolls, 4 rolls and 3 rolls, one for each person.
unavailable_text: The baskets are already on their way. Mr. Tobias says thank you!
